facts.fact: Law No. 025/2021 of 28 December 2021, published in Journal Officiel no. 145 of 1 January 2022, regulates electronic transactions in Gabon: it gives electronic acts, writings, signatures and invoices the same probative force as paper and sets rules for e-commerce, distance contracts and consumer withdrawal; the text gives no date of entry into force, so the promulgation date is used.
facts.system: Loi N° 025/2021 portant réglementation des transactions électroniques
